Home News Arts and Culture Business Sports Opinion Research Live TV/Radio Media Elections Dark Mode Dark mode --> HP News 10 | National GIS buries officer killed in Hamile dynamite explosion Source : adomonline 16 November 2026 11:36am ▶ Listen to this article Audio By Carbonatix
The Ghana Immigration Service (GIS) has held a solemn burial and thanksgiving service in honour of Immigration Control Officer (ICO) Shadrack Danso, who died following a dynamite explosion at a checkpoint along the Ghana-Burkina Faso border.
The ceremony, held at Kyebi in the Eastern Region, brought together family members, colleagues and other mourners to pay their final respects to the officer.
ICO Danso lost his life while on duty during an incident at Hamile in the Upper West Region, which involved an explosion believed to have been triggered by dynamite being transported on a motor tricycle.
The Ghana Immigration Service said he was a courageous, disciplined, and dedicated officer whose commitment to duty exemplified the highest ideals of the Service.
It described his death as a painful loss to the Service and the country, particularly given his dedication to protecting Ghana’s territorial integrity.
ICO Danso is survived by his wife, son, parents and five siblings.
The incident occurred in the early hours of Tuesday, November 3, 2026, at Hamile, a border community in the Lambussie District of the Upper West Region.
